source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper constructs an asymptotically uniformly valid confidence set for a simplex-valued optimizer/weight, including point- and set-identification cases.
The paper establishes predictor-selection consistency and a faster predictor-match MSE rate for a penalized sparse synthetic-control procedure.
The paper derives finite-sample optimal confidence intervals and sharp efficiency bounds for scalar linear functionals over convex regression-function classes.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Repair the local-center notation by defining c_{0,0}=d_0'A_0^+a_{0,0}, then restate every local derivative and the hinge reduction using centered quantities only.

Add a theorem that compares the unrestricted randomized max-diameter value with the best Freyberger--Rai nonrandom-shape value on a specified nondegenerate KKT configuration, establishing a strict separation when one exists.
Give the certified finite program an explicit input-size and numerical-enclosure complexity bound, including the number of KKT-cell pairwise SOCPs and the acceptance-subset optimization size.

recommended_next_step: Repair the local c0-versus-c_{0,0} defect, then advance the field-tier kernel to Stage 0 with the unrestricted-band comparison retained as its principal novelty test.
